data.camera: cowboy shot, pausing to smell a white rose in the royal garden
data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 王宫花园】王宫花园的午后，希斯特里亚脱下繁复的朝服换上浅色大衣，在花丛间慢慢踱步，金色长发披散下来，她弯腰轻嗅一朵白花——「这里的玫瑰，比墙外的野花要安静得多。」
data.promptProse: Historia pauses among the palace garden flowers, bending to smell a white rose in her pale queen's coat over a white shirt and trousers. Her loose blonde hair falls forward within the cowboy view. Flower beds overlap near her and the garden path continues behind. Gentle afternoon light passes across the rose petals and hair, with soft leaf shadows along her sleeve and beneath the open coat.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 王宫花园
